messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I was on my way down with 2 jars in my hands and full knowledge of the boxes upon boxes of glass jars surrounding me I am happy to report that only one jar was broken!

output.original_text: I was on my way down with 2 jars in my hands and full knowledge of the boxes upon boxes of glass jars surrounding me I am happy to report that only one jar was broken!
output.joy: I was on my way down with 2 jars in my hands, surrounded by countless boxes of glass jars, and I’m thrilled to share that only one jar was broken!
output.sadness: I was on my way down with 2 jars in my hands, fully aware of the boxes upon boxes of glass jars surrounding me, and it’s with a heavy heart that I say only one jar made it through unscathed.
output.fear: I was on my way down with 2 jars in my hands, dreading the sight of the boxes upon boxes of glass jars surrounding me, and I can hardly believe that only one jar broke!
output.anger: I was on my way down with 2 jars in my hands, surrounded by those annoying boxes upon boxes of glass jars, and it’s infuriating that only one jar was broken!
output.surprise: I was on my way down with 2 jars in my hands, among so many boxes of glass jars around me, and to my surprise, only one jar was broken!
output.disgust: I was on my way down with 2 jars in my hands, surrounded by all those boxes of glass jars, and honestly, I can’t believe that only one jar was broken!
